name: react-native-flux-desktop-gallery
description: Gallery demo app for react-native-flux-desktop — consumes it as an installed package (import { Button } from 'react-native-flux-desktop').

scripts.start: tsc && set FLUX_PACKAGED=1&& set FLUX_APP_DIR=ReactNativeFluxDesktopGallery&& node dist/App.js
scripts.start:gpu: tsc && set FLUX_GPU=1&& set FLUX_PACKAGED=1&& set FLUX_APP_DIR=ReactNativeFluxDesktopGallery&& node dist/App.js
